evidence.sql: SELECT p.week, MAX(p.defteam) AS opponent, SUM(p.pass) AS pass_plays, SUM(p.rush) AS rush_plays, ROUND(100 * SUM(p.pass) / NULLIF(SUM(p.pass) + SUM(p.rush), 0), 1) AS pass_rate_pct, MAX(CASE WHEN s.home_team = 'GB' THEN s.home_score - s.away_score ELSE s.away_score - s.home_score END) AS final_margin FROM NFLVERSE.pbp p JOIN NFLVERSE.schedules s ON s.game_id = p.game_id WHERE p.season = 2026 AND p.posteam = 'GB' GROUP BY p.week ORDER BY p.week

claims.text: Christian Watson's 11.2 yards per target this season is driven by a significant increase from 10.6 in weeks 1-3 to 13.9 in weeks 4-6, with air yards share rising from 30% to 34.8% over the same period.

However, his opportunity has declined sharply: snap share dropped from 82% in weeks 1-3 to 78.7% in weeks 4-6, and target share fell from 25.8% to 18.6%, causing PPR points per game to drop from 23.1 to 16.5. For fantasy production this season, his strong touchdown and red-zone efficiency (6 TDs, 20% of targets) and improved yards per target sustain value despite the opportunity decline. Verdict: start Christian Watson.
